inspiration.description: Start with an inspiration design: capture the idea, sketch the screens, scope this iteration
checklist: Must-have features for this iteration listed

animate.description: Animate (optional): add motion, transitions and micro-interactions

main-functionality.description: Build the main functionality: dashboard, widgets, core features
checklist: Widgets wired to data sources / API routes
Empty, loading and error states handled

local-testing.description: Test it locally and iterate: build, unit tests, typecheck
local-testing.command: cd web && npm run build && npm run test

db-testing.description: Push to the DB, test and iterate: start Postgres, migrate, seed
db-testing.command: cd web && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss --skip-generate && npm run db:rls && npx prisma db seed && set VIBE_DB_TESTS=1&& npm run test

authentication.description: Add authentication: login, register, sessions, route protection

deployment.description: Deploy: ship the build to Netlify (falls back to a build check if the CLI is missing)
checklist: Environment variables set on the host
Deployment succeeds and the site responds

e2e.description: Run E2E tests, polish misc designs and the landing page
